mentions.name: Crewbird
mentions.description: A field service management and CRM platform for service-based businesses with Google Local Service Ads integration, tracking every dollar of ad spend to determine return on ad spend; the author's father's carpet cleaning business is approaching 3x ROAS with it.
mentions.problem: The author's father's old Windows desktop CRM was discontinued and one OS update away from no longer working; the Google LSA dashboard left a lot to be desired for tracking spend and ROAS, and existing SaaS CRMs lacked good Google Ads API integrations.
mentions.source_excerpt: So I built Crewbird, a Field Service Management and CRM for service based businesses with Google LSA integration where my dad is quickly approaching 3x ROAS!
mentions.author: jzig
